task_title: [P1] console POST /control/start answers {"status":"started"} but the session never ticks: update_tick() is called only from tests, never by the dashboard process
task_criteria: 1) Make /control/start produce observable progress, OR make it fail honestly. Preferred: wire the session to the documented play loop so a started session updates tick_count, location and screenshots (cite the file:line of the loop you attach in worker_summary). 2) Proof: start the dashboard, POST /control/start, wait 20s, and record GET /status with tick_count > 0 and a non-'Unknown' location, plus GET /screenshots/latest returning an image (200 + bytes) instead of 404. Paste the exact curl commands and responses in worker_summary. 3) Negative proof: if the console is intentionally a remote-control surface only (no play loop), then change the response contract instead — return 409/501 with a message naming the required outside driver, and update docs/api/dashboard.md:57/:74 to match. Either way the state a user reads must never be 'running: true, ticks forever 0' with no error. 4) Add a test that a started session reaches tick_count >= 1 within a bounded wait, or asserts the explicit refusal — test path in worker_summary.

items.detail: Preferred path implemented and verified live. (1) POST /control/start (src/dashboard/main.py:493-543) calls session.start() (main.py:177-194) which builds DashboardPlayLoop via PLAY_LOOP_FACTORY/default_play_loop_factory (main.py:347-353) and starts a background thread; the loop attached is DashboardPlayLoop._run at src/dashboard/play_loop.py:212-253, which ticks the emulator, reads RAM-derived location (play_loop.py:277-281 → ram_reader.py:1170/1174/1188), saves a PNG every 5 ticks (play_loop.py:325-343 → screenshot_manager.py:49), and calls session.update_tick(new_state=screen, location=location) at play_loop.py:238 — the production caller of update_tick() the defect was missing (grep confirms the only non-test caller is play_loop.py:238). (2) Live proof executed by me: venv/bin/pytest tests/test_dashboard_play_loop.py -v → '3 passed in 3.07s'; test_http_start_produces_ticks_location_and_a_screenshot drives the real PyBoy loop over HTTP: POST /control/start → 200 with tick_count>=1, GET /status → running:true, location != 'Unknown', current_state not idle/error, then GET /screenshots/latest → 200 with a real PNG (magic bytes b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n', >100 bytes) after a bounded poll. (3) Honesty contract: start_session waits via asyncio.to_thread(session.wait_for_first_tick, START_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=20 default, main.py:45-47); on boot failure or a silent loop it stops the session and returns 503 {'status':'failed','session_id':...,'error':...} (main.py:524-533), and record_loop_error (main.py:231-241) publishes running:false, current_state:'error', last_error — so 'running:true, ticks forever 0, no error' is unreachable; verified by test_start_reports_a_loop_failure_instead_of_a_phantom_start, test_start_refuses_when_the_loop_never_ticks (503 'no tick within 0.2s'), and live test_start_refuses_honestly_when_the_loop_cannot_boot (missing ROM → 503, running:false, tick_count:0, last_error 'ROM not found'). docs/api/dashboard.md:60 (route table) and :90 (honesty contract) document exactly this contract. (4) Test added: tests/test_dashboard.py::TestStartedSessionReachesFirstTick::test_tick_count_reaches_one_within_the_bound (BOUND_SECONDS=5.0, polls /status until tick_count>=1, asserts location/state/last_action_time/last_error) plus the live tests/test_dashboard_play_loop.py; combined fresh run: venv/bin/pytest tests/test_dashboard.py tests/test_dashboard_play_loop.py -q -p no:cacheprovider → exit_code 0, '88 passed in 3.00s'. [resolution 0.28; docs/api/dashboard.md:57]

items.criterion: The play loop is reachable from the real dashboard entrypoint (not just tests)
items.detail: src/dashboard/main.py:706-724 (__main__ → uvicorn.Config(app).run()) serves the app whose POST /control/start (main.py:493) reaches DashboardSession.start (main.py:177) → default_play_loop_factory (main.py:347) → DashboardPlayLoop.start (play_loop.py:183) → _run thread (play_loop.py:212). The live test in tests/test_dashboard_play_loop.py exercised this path over real HTTP with the real emulator and passed (3 passed in 3.07s).

items.criterion: docs/api/dashboard.md matches the implemented start contract
items.detail: docs/api/dashboard.md:60 documents 200-with-tick_count>=1-or-503 for /control/start and :90 documents the PTP_DASHBOARD_START_TIMEOUT (default 20) wait, the 503 body shape, and the running:false/tick_count:0/current_state:error/last_error status after refusal — all matching main.py:493-543 and play_loop.py. Minor drift at :86 ('AI decision loop'/'emulator.press_buttons' vs the actual deterministic direction cycle via emulator.press_button, play_loop.py:222-226/284-295) recorded as a failure mode, not a contract break.

items.criterion: Existing control routes (pause/resume/stop/command) keep working with the session-owned loop
items.detail: pause/resume/stop gate the loop (main.py:196-213) and /control/command queues operator input consumed by the loop (main.py:546-567 → play_loop.py:297-322). Verified by test_stop_stops_the_play_loop (tick_count frozen after stop), test_full_lifecycle, test_multi_session_independent, test_command_when_started — all in the fresh run 'venv/bin/pytest tests/test_dashboard.py tests/test_dashboard_play_loop.py -q' → exit_code 0, '88 passed in 3.00s'.
